asset: LROC NAC DTM "NAC_DTM_APOLLO15" (2 m/px digital terrain model of the Apollo 15 site)
author: NASA / GSFC / Arizona State University
changes: Cropped to the play area, resampled and exported as three 16-bit heightmap LODs (30/10/5 m per px) plus derived normal maps by `scripts/process-terrain.sh` + `scripts/build-tiles.mjs`. No vertical exaggeration. Raw DTM not committed.

author: This project (original work)
changes: Built procedurally in three.js from public-domain NASA Apollo 15 surface photographs (Apollo Lunar Surface Journal image library, https://www.hq.nasa.gov/alsj/a15/images15.html); no third-party model files are used. Simplified, approximate geometry.
